Registers VM syscalls by name or slot, with feature-gated syscall selection.

# Purpose
This C file defines syscall registration helpers for the `fd_vm` virtual machine. The [`fd_vm_syscall_register`](<#fd_vm_syscall_register>) function adds one syscall entry to an `fd_sbpf_syscalls_t` map by hashing the syscall name, checking for invalid input, and storing the function pointer and name in the inserted slot. It returns `FD_VM_SUCCESS` on success and `FD_VM_ERR_INVAL` when the input is invalid or when the name already exists in the map.

The [`fd_vm_syscall_register_slot`](<#fd_vm_syscall_register_slot>) function builds the full syscall table for a given slot and feature set. It clears the current syscall map, then registers a fixed set of Solana-style syscalls and conditionally registers others based on `slot`, `features`, and `is_deploy`. Feature checks control support for syscalls such as `sol_blake3`, `sol_curve_validate_point`, `sol_alt_bn128_group_op`, `sol_poseidon`, and `sol_alt_bn128_compression`. The function also excludes `sol_alloc_free_` during deploy mode. This file therefore provides the external syscall interface used by the VM and controls which syscalls are active for a given runtime configuration.
